title: Adding font fallbacks in Import Defaults makes Godot unable to run embedded game window and corrupts project.godot
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: - 4.5.1.stable.official - 4.6.dev5 - 4.4.1.stable ### System information Windows 11 - Godot v4.5.1.stable.official - Vulkan (Forward+) - AMD Ryzen 7 9700X 8-Core Processor - Dedicated GPU NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti ### Issue description Adding Font Fallbacks Array in Project Settings -> Import Defaults will generate at error in the console: ` ERROR: scene/main/window.cpp:1050 - Attempting to make child window exclusive, but the parent window already has another exclusive child. This window: /root/@EditorNode@20438/@Panel@14/@EditorQuickOpenDialog@20362, parent window: /root, current exclusive child window: /root/@EditorNode@20438/@Panel@14/@ProjectSettingsEditor@2557` Attempting to run the project with font fallbacks in Import Defaults settings will open the Godot project manager screen (Godot starting screen whenever you run the Godot Engine .exe), as seen below Godot will also automatically switch the renderer to Compatibility Mode (OpenGL) and prints: `Embedded windows can't have a minimum size.` Closing Godot in this state and reopening will make the project marked by Godot as "Missing Project" and gives error "Unknown version" The project.godot file will not be able to be reimported into Godot Engine. If before quitting the project, all font fallbacks are removed from Import Defaults settings, the project will work as normal. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Make new project 2. Project Settings -> Import Defaults -> Importer: Font Data (Dynamic Fonts) 3. Fallbacks settings: Add element in Fallbacks Array. As soon as you click the quick load icon, the `ERROR: scene/main/window.cpp:1050` will print in the console. 4. Setting a valid font as fallback will reproduce the other errors. Godot will be unable to run the game and closing Godot will mark the project as "Missing project" on the Godot starting screen. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A. Reproducible in brand new project in Godot v4.5.1.stable.official
